name: enquiry_stays_in_query_mode
description: Two-intent separation: a general enquiry ('what flats / pricing do you have') is NOT a booking. It must stay in QUERY mode so the agent answers from inventory — it must not hijack the caller into the site_visit slot-filling flow. (See the two-intent design: site visit vs enquiry-lead.)

turns.text: I want to enquire about 2BHK flats and pricing
